```text
976	
977	`kill` does **not** flip a cancellation token in a running deadreckon process. If a deadreckon `run` is still running, `kill` only signals its child PIDs; the deadreckon process itself relies on its own cancellation token tree, which `kill` doesn't reach across processes. In practice this works because killing the children causes the providers/sandbox to error out, which the turn loop sees and propagates as a failure. This remains a hardening target.
978	
979	---
980	
981	## 13. Acceptance Gate & Anti-Self-Attestation
982	
983	### 13.1 The principle
984	
985	The agent (LLM) **cannot** be trusted to declare a run done. `Completed` is reachable only via an acceptance marker signed by an external binary that the agent does not have keys to.
986	
987	### 13.2 `AcceptanceMarker`
988	
989	`crates/deadreckon-core/src/gate.rs:16-28`:
990	
991	```rust
992	pub struct AcceptanceMarker {
993	    pub schema_version: u32,
994	    pub run_id: String,
995	    pub status: String,           // "pass" | "fail"
996	    pub produced_by: String,      // must be "dr-gate"
997	    pub checked_at: DateTime<Utc>,
998	    pub working_dir: PathBuf,
999	    pub signature: String,        // hash over fields + nonce
1000	    pub check_count: usize,
1001	}
1002	```
1003	
1004	Marker location: `<run_root>/proofs/turn-acceptance.json`.
1005	
1006	### 13.3 `dr-gate` binary
1007	
1008	`crates/deadreckon/src/bin/dr-gate.rs` (33 lines). Standalone binary that:
1009	
1010	1. Reads `--run <id>` and `--working-dir <path>`.
1011	2. Loads `acceptance.yaml` (if present) from the run root.
1012	3. Runs each check (cargo test, file-exists, content-match, build-success).
1013	4. If all required checks pass, writes a signed `AcceptanceMarker` to `proofs/turn-acceptance.json`.
1014	
1015	The marker's `signature` is computed from `gate/nonce` (a UUID written at run-init time by the deadreckon binary at `state.rs:188`). Only `dr-gate` reads the nonce; the agent never has access.
1016	
1017	### 13.4 Validation
1018	
1019	`gate.rs:88-118`:
1020	
1021	```rust
1022	pub fn validate_acceptance_marker(state: &PipelineState) -> Result<AcceptanceMarker> {
1023	    let path = marker_path(state);
1024	    let raw = std::fs::read(&path).with_path(&path)?;
1025	    let marker: AcceptanceMarker = serde_json::from_slice(&raw).with_json_path(&path)?;
1026	    if marker.schema_version != 1 { return Err(...); }
1027	    if marker.run_id != state.run_id {
1028	        return Err("acceptance marker run_id ... does not match");
1029	    }
1030	    if marker.status != "pass" || marker.produced_by != "dr-gate" {
1031	        return Err("acceptance marker was not produced by dr-gate with pass status");
1032	    }
1033	    let expected = marker_signature(&state.run_root, &marker)?;
1034	    if marker.signature != expected {
1035	        return Err("acceptance marker signature is invalid; forged self-attestation refused");
1036	    }
1037	    Ok(marker)
1038	}
1039	```
1040	
1041	A forged marker by the agent fails the signature check at line 114.
1042	
1043	### 13.5 Streaming progress
1044	
1045	While checks are running, `evaluate_acceptance_checks_with_progress` (`gate.rs:228-244`) appends one `AcceptanceProgressEntry` per state transition to `proofs/acceptance-progress.jsonl`:
1046	
1047	```rust
1048	pub struct AcceptanceProgressEntry {
1049	    pub checked_at: DateTime<Utc>,
1050	    pub status: String,        // "started" | "running" | "passed" | "failed"
1051	    pub index: usize,
1052	    pub total: usize,
1053	    pub result: Option<AcceptanceCheckResult>,
1054	}
1055	```
1056	
1057	The progress file is truncated at the start of each evaluation so resumed/extended runs do not mix with prior attempts. The attach TUI tails this file (§18) so operators can see acceptance advance from "running 2/5" → "passed 2/5" while `dr-gate` works. The signed `AcceptanceMarker` is still the load-bearing artifact; progress is observational telemetry only.
1058	
1059	### 13.6 Where the gate is invoked
1060	
1061	When the turn loop emits `Action::Done` — either through a CLI sub-agent finishing or a JSON-action provider returning `Done` — it routes through `acceptance_gate_passed_or_record_failure` (`crates/deadreckon-runtime/src/turn_loop.rs:1298`). Both call sites (`turn_loop.rs:359` for JSON Done, `turn_loop.rs:615` for CLI sub-agent Done) use this helper.
1062	
1063	The helper composes `run_acceptance_gate` (invokes `dr-gate` as a subprocess) and `validate_acceptance_marker` (signature + run_id check):
1064	
1065	- **If the gate passes:** the helper returns `true` and the loop continues into `promote_if_ready`.
1066	- **If the gate fails:** the helper logs `acceptance.failed` to `traces.jsonl`, appends an explicit corrective hint to the run history (`"acceptance failed after turn N: <reason>. Continue by fixing the failing done criteria; do not declare done until dr-gate passes."`), emits a `RunEventKind::Error` event, records the reason in `state.failure_reason`, and **returns `false` — the run does not terminate**.
1067	
1068	The agent sees the failure inside the next turn doc and can revise the working tree and re-declare `Done`. Only when the turn budget is exhausted does the run fail; at that point the accumulated reasons in `state.failure_reason` become the final `failure_reason` text (`turn_loop.rs:633`).
1069	
1070	---
1071	
1072	## 14. Telemetry: Spend, Traces, Provenance, Events
1073	
1074	Five append-only JSONL files capture every run's history. Four (`spend.jsonl`, `traces.jsonl`, `provenance.jsonl`, `events.jsonl`) live under `<run_root>/` directly; the fifth (`proofs/acceptance-progress.jsonl`, see §13.5) is gate-scoped and truncated per evaluation. All are written via `append_json_line` (`state.rs:375-388`), which opens in append mode and `sync_all`s after each line.

1089	  "cost_usd": 0.0,
1090	  "subscription": true,
1091	  "wall_time_seconds": 42.1
1092	}
1093	```
1094	
1095	One line per LLM call. HTTP providers fill in token counts and USD; CLI providers fill in `subscription: true` + `wall_time_seconds`.

1104	  "run_id": "...",
1105	  "turn": 3,

async fn attach_tui_with_parent(
    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
    run_id: &str,
    show_completion_actions: bool,
    parent_plan: Option<AttachParentPlan>,
    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
) -> Result<()> {
    let initial_state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
    let mut event_feed =
        tui_events::TuiEventFeed::file_tail(initial_state.run_root.join(RUN_EVENTS_JSONL));
    let mut events = event_feed.refresh(std::time::Duration::ZERO).await?;
    enable_raw_mode()?;
    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
    let mut tui_state = AttachTuiState {
        show_completion_actions,
        parent_plan,
        view: initial_view,
        visual: initial_visual,
        ..AttachTuiState::default()

1057:The progress file is truncated at the start of each evaluation so resumed/extended runs do not mix with prior attempts. The attach TUI tails this file (§18) so operators can see acceptance advance from "running 2/5" → "passed 2/5" while `dr-gate` works. The signed `AcceptanceMarker` is still the load-bearing artifact; progress is observational telemetry only.
1196:`deadreckon import` is the *user-driven* ingest. The *TUI-driven* ingest path that lets `attach` read live provider transcripts uses the same descriptor `[ingest]` roots, env overrides, storage kinds, file globs, freshness windows, cwd matching, and schema keys for CLI providers; see §18.3 and `docs/design/PROVIDER-CLI-INGEST.md`. OpenCode SQLite, provider transcript mutation/undo, full replay UI, and cross-run import analytics remain V1 candidates in `docs/V1-CANDIDATES.md`.
1291:### 18.3 Data source
1295:Same-process run attaches can use the `RunEventBus` broadcast channel directly; cross-process run attaches still poll. Plan attach is different after the live-UX slice: it consumes `PlanEventBus` / `PlanEventFeed`, which owns `plan-events.jsonl` replay/tailing, emits plan snapshots, tolerates malformed or partial plan-event rows, and multiplexes discovered child and repair run `events.jsonl` streams into the plan activity pane. The production feed remains durable-file backed for cross-process attach, with a broadcast-capable API available for same-process plan streams.
1488:- Event-backed TUI attach: same-process attaches use `RunEventBus`; cross-process attaches replay `events.jsonl` incrementally.
1962:The plan event feed is still durable-file backed for cross-process attach, and long-lived same-process plan writers are not yet all routed through a shared broadcaster. The TUI no longer owns raw `read_plan_events_lossy` polling, but child and repair run detail still ultimately comes from normal run files. There is also no arbitrary child-to-child chat surface: children communicate through durable summaries and typed coordinator messages only.
2033:The plan event stream is durable and replayable, and plan attach now subscribes to a single `PlanEventBus` feed abstraction. The feed is broadcast-capable in-process, but production plan writers still primarily communicate through append-only JSONL so cross-process attach remains reliable. A future embedded attach mode could pass a long-lived broadcaster through every plan writer for lower-latency same-process delivery.

1291	### 18.3 Data source
1292	
1293	The run TUI still polls run files on disk every 500 ms: `spend.jsonl`, `traces.jsonl`, `events.jsonl`, `proofs/acceptance-progress.jsonl`, `proofs/turn-acceptance.json`, plus provider-native logs when the active provider writes them. `collect_provider_activity` now resolves provider ingest through descriptor `[ingest]` metadata: candidate roots, env overrides, cwd matching, storage kind, file glob, freshness window, and schema key. `deadreckon import` reuses the same descriptor metadata for provider transcript discovery and adds import-only session selection, manifest writing, and normalized trace/provenance event creation. `cli:codex` reads `~/.codex/sessions/**.jsonl` and matches `session_meta.payload.cwd`; `cli:claude-code` reads `~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/*.jsonl` using Claude Code's path-to-project mapping and matches top-level `cwd`; `cli:gemini` reads Gemini JSON/JSONL file logs; `cli:opencode` reads OpenCode file-mode `storage/session`, `storage/message`, and `storage/part` JSON; `cli:copilot` reads `~/.copilot/session-state/*.jsonl` plus nested `events.jsonl` and matches `data.context.cwd`; `cli:pi` reads `~/.pi/agent/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/*.jsonl`, validates the first nonblank row is a Pi `session`, and matches the header `cwd`. The shared collector handles candidate discovery, recency filtering, run matching, stream capping, and context telemetry. Schema-specific adapters only decode rows into common activity lines (`agent`, `thinking`, `tool`, `result`, `todo`, `tokens`) and normalize tool labels through `deadreckon_providers::taxonomy`.

365	pub fn build_working_file_index(root: &Path) -> Result<WorkingFileIndex> {
366	    let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
367	    if !root.exists() {
368	        return Ok(WorkingFileIndex { files });
369	    }
370	    for entry in WalkDir::new(root)
371	        .into_iter()
372	        .filter_entry(|entry| !ignored_working_entry(entry.path(), root))
373	    {
374	        let entry = entry.map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
375	            path: root.to_path_buf(),
376	            source: source.into(),
377	        })?;
378	        if !entry.file_type().is_file() {
379	            continue;
380	        }
381	        let path = entry.path();
382	        let relative = path.strip_prefix(root).map_err(|err| {
383	            DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!("working path prefix error: {err}"))
384	        })?;
385	        let metadata = fs::metadata(path).with_path(path)?;
386	        files.insert(
387	            relative.to_path_buf(),
388	            FileFingerprint {
389	                hash: sha256_file(path)?,
390	                size: metadata.len(),
391	            },
392	        );
393	    }
394	    Ok(WorkingFileIndex { files })
395	}

397	pub fn capture_delta_checkpoint(
398	    state: &PipelineState,
399	    before: &WorkingFileIndex,
400	    after: &WorkingFileIndex,
401	    request: CheckpointCaptureRequest,
402	) -> Result<CheckpointManifest> {
403	    let checkpoints = checkpoints_dir(state);
404	    fs::create_dir_all(&checkpoints).with_path(&checkpoints)?;
405	    let final_dir = checkpoints.join(&request.checkpoint_id);
406	    let tmp_dir = checkpoints.join(format!(".tmp-{}", request.checkpoint_id));
407	    if tmp_dir.exists() {
408	        fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir).with_path(&tmp_dir)?;
409	    }
410	    if final_dir.exists() {
411	        fs::remove_dir_all(&final_dir).with_path(&final_dir)?;
412	    }
413	    fs::create_dir_all(&tmp_dir).with_path(&tmp_dir)?;
414	
415	    let mut files = Vec::new();
416	    for (relative, after_fingerprint) in &after.files {
417	        match before.files.get(relative) {
418	            None => {
419	                copy_checkpoint_file(&state.working_dir, &tmp_dir, relative)?;
420	                files.push(CheckpointFileChange {
421	                    path: relative.clone(),
422	                    change: CheckpointChangeKind::Created,
423	                    before_hash: None,
424	                    after_hash: Some(after_fingerprint.hash.clone()),
425	                    after_bytes: Some(PathBuf::from("files").join(relative)),
426	                });
427	            }
428	            Some(before_fingerprint) if before_fingerprint.hash != after_fingerprint.hash => {
429	                copy_checkpoint_file(&state.working_dir, &tmp_dir, relative)?;
430	                files.push(CheckpointFileChange {
431	                    path: relative.clone(),
432	                    change: CheckpointChangeKind::Modified,
433	                    before_hash: Some(before_fingerprint.hash.clone()),
434	                    after_hash: Some(after_fingerprint.hash.clone()),
435	                    after_bytes: Some(PathBuf::from("files").join(relative)),
436	                });
437	            }
438	            Some(_) => {}
439	        }
440	    }
441	    for (relative, before_fingerprint) in &before.files {
442	        if after.files.contains_key(relative) {
443	            continue;
444	        }
445	        files.push(CheckpointFileChange {
446	            path: relative.clone(),
447	            change: CheckpointChangeKind::Deleted,
448	            before_hash: Some(before_fingerprint.hash.clone()),
449	            after_hash: None,
450	            after_bytes: None,
451	        });
452	    }
453	
454	    if request.full_anchor {
455	        copy_tree(&state.working_dir, &tmp_dir.join("anchor"))?;
456	    }
457	
458	    let manifest = CheckpointManifest {
459	        version: 1,
460	        checkpoint_id: request.checkpoint_id.clone(),
461	        run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
462	        flight_session_id: request.flight_session_id,
463	        deadreckon_turn: request.deadreckon_turn,
464	        attempt: request.attempt,
465	        provider_event_seq: request.provider_event_seq,
466	        created_at: Utc::now(),
467	        trigger: request.trigger,
468	        base: request.base,
469	        full_anchor: request.full_anchor,
470	        files,
471	        working_tree_hash: after.tree_hash(),
472	    };
473	    write_json_pretty_atomic(&tmp_dir.join("manifest.json"), &manifest)?;
474	    fs::rename(&tmp_dir, &final_dir).with_path(&final_dir)?;
475	    Ok(manifest)
476	}
477	
478	pub fn materialize_checkpoint(
479	    state: &PipelineState,
480	    checkpoint_id: &str,
481	    output_dir: &Path,
482	) -> Result<CheckpointManifest> {
483	    let target = read_checkpoint_manifest(state, checkpoint_id)?;
484	    let manifests = list_checkpoint_manifests(state)?;
485	    let session_manifests = manifests
486	        .into_iter()
487	        .filter(|manifest| {
488	            manifest.flight_session_id == target.flight_session_id
489	                && manifest.attempt == target.attempt
490	                && manifest.checkpoint_id <= target.checkpoint_id
491	        })
492	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
493	
494	    if output_dir.exists() {
495	        fs::remove_dir_all(output_dir).with_path(output_dir)?;
496	    }
497	    if let Some(anchor) = session_manifests
498	        .iter()
499	        .rev()
500	        .find(|manifest| manifest.full_anchor && manifest.checkpoint_id <= target.checkpoint_id)
501	    {
502	        let anchor_dir = checkpoint_dir(state, &anchor.checkpoint_id).join("anchor");
503	        copy_tree(&anchor_dir, output_dir)?;
504	        for manifest in session_manifests
505	            .iter()
506	            .filter(|manifest| manifest.checkpoint_id > anchor.checkpoint_id)
507	        {
508	            apply_checkpoint_delta(state, output_dir, manifest)?;
509	        }
510	        return Ok(target);
511	    }
512	
513	    let base_dir = base_dir_for_checkpoint(state, &target.base);
514	    copy_tree(&base_dir, output_dir)?;
515	    for manifest in &session_manifests {
516	        apply_checkpoint_delta(state, output_dir, manifest)?;
517	    }
518	    Ok(target)
519	}

521	impl WorkingFileIndex {
522	    pub fn tree_hash(&self) -> String {
523	        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
524	        for (path, fingerprint) in &self.files {
525	            hasher.update(path.to_string_lossy().as_bytes());
526	            hasher.update(b"\0");
527	            hasher.update(fingerprint.hash.as_bytes());
528	            hasher.update(b"\0");
529	        }
530	        let digest = hasher.finalize();
531	        format_sha256(&digest)
532	    }
533	}
534	
535	pub fn sha256_text(text: &str) -> String {
536	    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
537	    hasher.update(text.as_bytes());
538	    let digest = hasher.finalize();
539	    format_sha256(&digest)
540	}
541	
542	pub fn sha256_file(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {
543	    let mut file = fs::File::open(path).with_path(path)?;
544	    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
545	    let mut buffer = [0_u8; 8192];
546	    loop {
547	        let read = file.read(&mut buffer).with_path(path)?;
548	        if read == 0 {
549	            break;
550	        }
551	        hasher.update(&buffer[..read]);
552	    }
553	    let digest = hasher.finalize();
554	    Ok(format_sha256(&digest))
555	}
556	
557	fn read_jsonl<T>(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<T>>
558	where
559	    T: for<'de> Deserialize<'de>,
560	{
561	    if !path.exists() {
562	        return Ok(Vec::new());
563	    }
564	    let raw = fs::read_to_string(path).with_path(path)?;
565	    raw.lines()
566	        .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
567	        .map(|line| {
568	            serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
569	                path: path.to_path_buf(),
570	                source,
571	            })
572	        })
573	        .collect()
574	}

576	fn ignored_working_entry(path: &Path, root: &Path) -> bool {
577	    let relative = path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap_or(path);
578	    relative.components().any(|component| {
579	        let value = component.as_os_str().to_string_lossy();
580	        matches!(
581	            value.as_ref(),
582	            ".git" | ".deadreckon" | "target" | "node_modules"
583	        )
584	    })
585	}

587	fn copy_checkpoint_file(working_dir: &Path, checkpoint_tmp: &Path, relative: &Path) -> Result<()> {
588	    let source = working_dir.join(relative);
589	    let dest = checkpoint_tmp.join("files").join(relative);
590	    if let Some(parent) = dest.parent() {
591	        fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
592	    }
593	    fs::copy(&source, &dest).with_path(&dest)?;
594	    Ok(())
595	}
596	
597	fn apply_checkpoint_delta(
598	    state: &PipelineState,
599	    output_dir: &Path,
600	    manifest: &CheckpointManifest,
601	) -> Result<()> {
602	    let checkpoint = checkpoint_dir(state, &manifest.checkpoint_id);
603	    for change in &manifest.files {
604	        let target = output_dir.join(&change.path);
605	        match change.change {
606	            CheckpointChangeKind::Created | CheckpointChangeKind::Modified => {
607	                let after = change.after_bytes.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
608	                    DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
609	                        "checkpoint {} missing after_bytes for {}",
610	                        manifest.checkpoint_id,
611	                        change.path.display()
612	                    ))
613	                })?;
614	                if let Some(parent) = target.parent() {
615	                    fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
616	                }
617	                fs::copy(checkpoint.join(after), &target).with_path(&target)?;
618	            }
619	            CheckpointChangeKind::Deleted => {
620	                if target.exists() {
621	                    fs::remove_file(&target).with_path(&target)?;
622	                }
623	            }
624	            CheckpointChangeKind::SkippedOversize => {}
625	        }
626	    }
627	    Ok(())
628	}
629	
630	fn base_dir_for_checkpoint(state: &PipelineState, base: &CheckpointBase) -> PathBuf {
631	    match base.kind {
632	        CheckpointBaseKind::TurnSnapshot => {
633	            let id = base.id.strip_prefix("turn-").unwrap_or(&base.id);
634	            state.run_root.join("snapshots").join(format!("turn-{id}"))
635	        }
636	        CheckpointBaseKind::CheckpointAnchor => checkpoint_dir(state, &base.id).join("anchor"),
637	    }
638	}
639	
640	fn write_json_pretty_atomic<T: Serialize>(path: &Path, value: &T) -> Result<()> {
641	    let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
642	        DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!("path has no parent: {}", path.display()))
643	    })?;
644	    fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
645	    let mut temp = NamedTempFile::new_in(parent).with_path(parent)?;
646	    serde_json::to_writer_pretty(&mut temp, value).with_json_path(path)?;
647	    temp.write_all(b"\n").with_path(path)?;
648	    temp.as_file_mut().sync_all().with_path(path)?;
649	    match temp.persist(path) {
650	        Ok(_) => Ok(()),
651	        Err(err) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io {
652	            path: path.to_path_buf(),
653	            source: err.error,
654	        }),
655	    }
656	}
657	
658	fn format_sha256(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
659	    let mut out = String::with_capacity("sha256:".len() + bytes.len() * 2);
660	    out.push_str("sha256:");
661	    for byte in bytes {
662	        use std::fmt::Write as _;
663	        let _ = write!(&mut out, "{byte:02x}");
664	    }
665	    out
666	}

427	pub fn index_learning(
428	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
429	    options: &LearningIndexOptions,
430	) -> Result<LearningIndexSummary> {
431	    let mut summary = LearningIndexSummary::default();
432	    let mut episodes = Vec::new();
433	    for state_path in discover_state_paths(paths) {
434	        let Ok(state) = load_state(&state_path) else {
435	            summary.skipped_corrupt += 1;
436	            continue;
437	        };
438	        if options
439	            .scope
440	            .as_ref()
441	            .is_some_and(|scope| scope != &state.scope)
442	        {
443	            continue;
444	        }
445	        if !is_terminal_status(state.status) {
446	            summary.skipped_live += 1;
447	            continue;
448	        }
449	        let episode = episode_from_state(paths, &state)?;
450	        if write_episode(paths, &episode)? == WriteStatus::Wrote {
451	            summary.indexed += 1;
452	        }
453	        summary.scopes.push(episode.scope.clone());
454	        episodes.push((episode, state));
455	    }
456	    summary.scopes.sort();
457	    summary.scopes.dedup();
458	
459	    let existing_signals = read_signals(paths).unwrap_or_default();
460	    let mut seen_signal_ids = existing_signals
461	        .iter()
462	        .map(|signal| signal.signal_id.clone())
463	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
464	    let signals = extract_signals(&episodes);
465	    for signal in signals {
466	        if seen_signal_ids.insert(signal.signal_id.clone()) {
467	            append_json_line(&paths.learning_signals_path(), &signal)?;
468	            summary.signals_written += 1;
469	        }
470	    }
471	
472	    Ok(summary)
473	}

509	pub fn learning_report(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, scope: Option<&str>) -> Result<LearningReport> {
510	    let mut episodes = 0usize;
511	    if paths.learning_dir().join("episodes").exists() {
512	        for entry in WalkDir::new(paths.learning_dir().join("episodes"))
513	            .into_iter()
514	            .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
515	            .filter(|entry| entry.file_type().is_file())
516	        {
517	            if entry.path().extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) != Some("json") {
518	                continue;
519	            }
520	            let episode = read_episode(entry.path())?;
521	            if scope.is_none_or(|scope| scope == episode.scope) {
522	                episodes += 1;
523	            }
524	        }
525	    }
526	
527	    let signals = read_signals(paths).unwrap_or_default();
528	    let mut filtered_signals = Vec::new();
529	    for signal in signals {
530	        if let Some(scope) = scope
531	            && !signal_belongs_to_scope(paths, &signal, scope)
532	        {
533	            continue;
534	        }
535	        filtered_signals.push(signal);
536	    }
537	    let mut signals_by_kind = BTreeMap::new();
538	    for signal in &filtered_signals {
539	        *signals_by_kind.entry(signal.kind.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
540	    }
541	    filtered_signals.sort_by(|left, right| {
542	        right
543	            .severity
544	            .cmp(&left.severity)
545	            .then_with(|| right.confidence.total_cmp(&left.confidence))
546	    });
547	    let insights = read_insights(paths).unwrap_or_default().len();
548	    let proposals = count_proposals(paths)?;
549	
550	    Ok(LearningReport {
551	        episodes,
552	        signals: filtered_signals.len(),
553	        insights,
554	        proposals,
555	        signals_by_kind,
556	        top_signals: filtered_signals.into_iter().take(10).collect(),
557	    })
558	}

671	pub fn export_learning_bundle(
672	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
673	    source_id: &str,
674	    output: &Path,
675	) -> Result<LearningBundleExportReport> {
676	    let (source_kind, episodes, signals, insights, proposals) =
677	        bundle_records_for_source(paths, source_id)?;
678	    let bundle_id = deterministic_id("bundle", &format!("{source_kind}:{source_id}"));
679	    let mut redaction = RedactionReport {
680	        profile: "local-v1".to_string(),
681	        findings: Vec::new(),
682	    };
683	    let mut bundle = LearningBundle {
684	        version: LEARNING_SCHEMA_VERSION,
685	        bundle_id: bundle_id.clone(),
686	        generated_at: Utc::now(),
687	        source_kind,
688	        source_id: source_id.to_string(),
689	        redacted: true,
690	        redaction: redaction.clone(),
691	        hashes: BTreeMap::new(),
692	        episodes: redact_bundle_values(episodes, paths, &mut redaction.findings),
693	        signals: redact_bundle_values(signals, paths, &mut redaction.findings),
694	        insights: redact_bundle_values(insights, paths, &mut redaction.findings),
695	        proposals: redact_bundle_values(proposals, paths, &mut redaction.findings),
696	    };
697	    redaction.findings.sort();
698	    redaction.findings.dedup();
699	    bundle.redaction = redaction.clone();
700	    bundle.hashes = bundle_hashes(&bundle)?;
701	    write_if_changed(
702	        output,
703	        &serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&bundle).with_json_path(output)?,
704	    )?;
705	    Ok(LearningBundleExportReport {
706	        bundle_id,
707	        output: output.to_path_buf(),
708	        episodes: bundle.episodes.len(),
709	        signals: bundle.signals.len(),
710	        insights: bundle.insights.len(),
711	        proposals: bundle.proposals.len(),
712	        redaction,
713	    })
714	}

724	pub fn import_learning_bundle(
725	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
726	    path: &Path,
727	    apply: bool,
728	) -> Result<LearningBundleImportReport> {
729	    let bundle = read_learning_bundle(path)?;
730	    let report = LearningBundleImportReport {
731	        bundle_id: bundle.bundle_id.clone(),
732	        preview: !apply,
733	        applied: apply,
734	        episodes: bundle.episodes.len(),
735	        signals: bundle.signals.len(),
736	        insights: bundle.insights.len(),
737	        proposals: bundle.proposals.len(),
738	    };
739	    if !apply {
740	        return Ok(report);
741	    }
742	
743	    for episode in bundle_records::<LearningEpisode>(&bundle.episodes, path)? {
744	        atomic_write_json(
745	            &paths.learning_episode_path(&episode.scope, &episode.run_id),
746	            &episode,
747	        )?;
748	    }
749	
750	    let mut existing_signals = read_signals(paths)
751	        .unwrap_or_default()
752	        .into_iter()
753	        .map(|signal| signal.signal_id)
754	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
755	    for signal in bundle_records::<LearningSignal>(&bundle.signals, path)? {
756	        if existing_signals.insert(signal.signal_id.clone()) {
757	            append_json_line(&paths.learning_signals_path(), &signal)?;
758	        }
759	    }
760	
761	    let mut existing_insights = read_insights(paths)
762	        .unwrap_or_default()
763	        .into_iter()
764	        .map(|insight| insight.insight_id)
765	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
766	    for insight in bundle_records::<LearningInsight>(&bundle.insights, path)? {
767	        if existing_insights.insert(insight.insight_id.clone()) {
768	            append_json_line(&paths.learning_insights_path(), &insight)?;
769	        }
770	    }
771	
772	    for proposal in bundle_records::<LearningProposal>(&bundle.proposals, path)? {
773	        atomic_write_json(
774	            &paths.learning_proposal_path(&proposal.proposal_id),
775	            &proposal,
776	        )?;
777	    }
778	
779	    Ok(report)
780	}

782	pub fn persist_reflection(
783	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
784	    provider: &LearningInsightProvider,
785	    raw_json: &str,
786	    limit: usize,
787	) -> Result<ProposalGenerationReport> {
788	    let available_signals = read_signals(paths)?
789	        .into_iter()
790	        .map(|signal| (signal.signal_id, signal.run_id))
791	        .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
792	    let envelope: ReflectionEnvelope =
793	        serde_json::from_str(raw_json).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
794	            path: paths.learning_dir().join("reflection-response.json"),
795	            source,
796	        })?;
797	    if envelope.insights.is_empty() || envelope.proposals.is_empty() {
798	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
799	            "reflection JSON must include non-empty insights and proposals".to_string(),
800	        ));
801	    }
802	    let now = Utc::now();
803	    let mut insights_written = Vec::new();
804	    for insight in envelope.insights.into_iter().take(limit) {
805	        validate_stimulus(&available_signals, &insight.stimulus)?;
806	        let insight_id = deterministic_id(
807	            "ins",
808	            &json!({
809	                "summary": insight.summary,
810	                "stimulus": insight.stimulus
811	            })
812	            .to_string(),
813	        );
814	        let coverage = evidence_coverage(&insight.stimulus);
815	        let persisted = LearningInsight {
816	            version: LEARNING_SCHEMA_VERSION,
817	            insight_id: insight_id.clone(),
818	            created_at: now,
819	            provider: provider.clone(),
820	            stimulus: insight.stimulus,
821	            summary: insight.summary,
822	            user_need: insight.user_need,
823	            hypothesis: insight.hypothesis,
824	            confidence: insight.confidence,
825	            evidence_coverage: coverage,
826	            rejected_claims: insight.rejected_claims,
827	        };
828	        append_json_line(&paths.learning_insights_path(), &persisted)?;
829	        insights_written.push(persisted);
830	    }
831	
832	    let insight_ids = insights_written
833	        .iter()
834	        .map(|insight| insight.insight_id.clone())
835	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
836	    let mut proposals = Vec::new();
837	    for proposal in envelope.proposals.into_iter().take(limit) {
838	        validate_stimulus(&available_signals, &proposal.stimulus)?;
839	        if proposal.done_criteria.is_empty() {
840	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
841	                "proposal must include testable done criteria".to_string(),
842	            ));
843	        }
844	        let proposal_id = deterministic_id(
845	            "prop",
846	            &json!({
847	                "title": proposal.title,
848	                "goal": proposal.goal_text,
849	                "stimulus": proposal.stimulus
850	            })
851	            .to_string(),
852	        );
853	        let proposal_insights = if proposal.insights.is_empty() {
854	            insight_ids.iter().cloned().collect()
855	        } else {
856	            proposal.insights
857	        };
858	        let persisted = LearningProposal {
859	            version: LEARNING_SCHEMA_VERSION,
860	            proposal_id: proposal_id.clone(),
861	            created_at: now,
862	            title: proposal.title,
863	            insights: proposal_insights,
864	            stimulus: proposal.stimulus,
865	            hypothesis: proposal.hypothesis,
866	            target: proposal.target,
867	            goal_text: proposal.goal_text,
868	            done_criteria: proposal.done_criteria,
869	            expected_risk: proposal.expected_risk,
870	            blocked_auto_pr_reasons: proposal.blocked_auto_pr_reasons,
871	        };
872	        atomic_write_json(&paths.learning_proposal_path(&proposal_id), &persisted)?;
873	        proposals.push(persisted);
874	    }
875	
876	    Ok(ProposalGenerationReport {
877	        insights_written: insights_written.len(),
878	        proposals_written: proposals.len(),
879	        proposals,
880	    })
881	}

883	pub fn classify_candidate_risk(changed_files: &[String]) -> LearningRisk {
884	    let mut reasons = Vec::new();
885	    for file in changed_files {
886	        if is_high_risk_path(file) {
887	            reasons.push(file.clone());
888	        }
889	    }
890	    let class = if reasons.is_empty() { "low" } else { "high" }.to_string();
891	    LearningRisk { class, reasons }
892	}
893	
894	pub fn evidence_score(
895	    proposal: &LearningProposal,
896	    candidate: &LearningCandidate,
897	    eval: &LearningEval,
898	) -> f64 {
899	    let mut score = 0.0;
900	    if !proposal.stimulus.is_empty() {
901	        score += 0.20;
902	    }
903	    if eval.accepted_run {
904	        score += 0.20;
905	    }
906	    if eval.commands.iter().all(|command| command.status == 0) && !eval.commands.is_empty() {
907	        score += 0.20;
908	    }
909	    if candidate.risk.class != "high" && candidate.diff.files > 0 {
910	        score += 0.15;
911	    }
912	    if eval.docs_updated {
913	        score += 0.10;
914	    }
915	    if eval.redaction_passed {
916	        score += 0.10;
917	    }
918	    if !candidate.evidence_packet.is_empty() && !candidate.branch.is_empty() {
919	        score += 0.05;
920	    }
921	    score
922	}
923	
924	pub fn evaluate_auto_pr(
925	    proposal: &LearningProposal,
926	    candidate: &LearningCandidate,
927	    eval: &LearningEval,
928	    policy: &LearningPolicy,
929	    explicit_open_pr: bool,
930	) -> AutoPrDecision {
931	    let mut reasons = Vec::new();
932	    if !explicit_open_pr && !policy.pr.auto_open {
933	        reasons.push("PR opening requires --open-pr or learning.pr.auto_open".to_string());
934	    }
935	    if candidate.worktree.as_os_str().is_empty() && policy.self_run.require_isolated_worktree {
936	        reasons.push("candidate must use an isolated worktree".to_string());
937	    }
938	    if proposal.done_criteria.is_empty() {
939	        reasons.push("proposal has weak or missing done criteria".to_string());
940	    }
941	    if !eval.accepted_run {
942	        reasons.push("candidate run was not accepted".to_string());
943	    }
944	    if eval.commands.is_empty() || eval.commands.iter().any(|command| command.status != 0) {
945	        reasons.push("focused verification did not pass".to_string());
946	    }
947	    if !eval.redaction_passed {
948	        reasons.push("redaction or secrets scan failed".to_string());
949	    }
950	    if eval.evidence_score < policy.pr.min_evidence_score {
951	        reasons.push(format!(
952	            "evidence score {:.2} is below {:.2}",
953	            eval.evidence_score, policy.pr.min_evidence_score
954	        ));
955	    }
956	    if policy.pr.block_high_risk && candidate.risk.class == "high" {
957	        reasons.push(format!(
958	            "high-risk diff blocked: {}",
959	            candidate.risk.reasons.join(", ")
960	        ));
961	    }
962	    if candidate.base_commit == candidate.head_commit {
963	        reasons.push("candidate head matches base commit".to_string());
964	    }
965	
966	    AutoPrDecision {
967	        eligible: reasons.is_empty(),
968	        reasons,
969	    }
970	}

972	pub fn prepare_pr_dry_run(
973	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
974	    proposal: &LearningProposal,
975	    candidate: &LearningCandidate,
976	    eval: &LearningEval,
977	    policy: &LearningPolicy,
978	    explicit_open_pr: bool,
979	) -> Result<PrDryRun> {
980	    let decision = evaluate_auto_pr(proposal, candidate, eval, policy, explicit_open_pr);
981	    let title = format!("Self-improve: {}", proposal.title);
982	    let body = build_pr_body(proposal, candidate, eval, &decision);
983	    let body_path = paths
984	        .learning_candidate_dir(&candidate.candidate_id)
985	        .join("pr-body.md");
986	    write_if_changed(&body_path, body.as_bytes())?;
987	    append_json_line(
988	        &paths.learning_pr_events_path(),
989	        &LearningPrEvent {
990	            version: LEARNING_SCHEMA_VERSION,
991	            timestamp: Utc::now(),
992	            candidate_id: candidate.candidate_id.clone(),
993	            mode: "dry-run".to_string(),
994	            status: if decision.eligible {
995	                "prepared".to_string()
996	            } else {
997	                "refused".to_string()
998	            },
999	            branch: candidate.branch.clone(),
1000	            pr_url: None,
1001	            body_path: path_relative_to(&body_path, paths.home()),
1002	            reason: (!decision.eligible).then(|| decision.reasons.join("; ")),
1003	        },
1004	    )?;
1005	    Ok(PrDryRun {
1006	        title,
1007	        body,
1008	        body_path,
1009	        branch: candidate.branch.clone(),
1010	        decision,
1011	    })
1012	}

1038	type BundleRecordValues = (String, Vec<Value>, Vec<Value>, Vec<Value>, Vec<Value>);
1039	
1040	fn bundle_records_for_source(
1041	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1042	    source_id: &str,
1043	) -> Result<BundleRecordValues> {
1044	    let episodes = read_all_episodes(paths)?;
1045	    let signals = read_signals(paths).unwrap_or_default();
1046	    let insights = read_insights(paths).unwrap_or_default();
1047	    let proposals = read_all_proposals(paths)?;
1048	
1049	    if let Some(proposal) = proposals
1050	        .iter()
1051	        .find(|proposal| proposal.proposal_id == source_id)
1052	        .cloned()
1053	    {
1054	        let signal_ids = proposal
1055	            .stimulus
1056	            .iter()
1057	            .map(|item| item.signal_id.as_str())
1058	            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1059	        let run_ids = proposal
1060	            .stimulus
1061	            .iter()
1062	            .map(|item| item.run_id.as_str())
1063	            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1064	        let insight_ids = proposal
1065	            .insights
1066	            .iter()
1067	            .map(String::as_str)
1068	            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1069	        return Ok((
1070	            "proposal".to_string(),
1071	            to_values(
1072	                episodes
1073	                    .into_iter()
1074	                    .filter(|episode| run_ids.contains(episode.run_id.as_str()))
1075	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1076	            )?,
1077	            to_values(
1078	                signals
1079	                    .into_iter()
1080	                    .filter(|signal| signal_ids.contains(signal.signal_id.as_str()))
1081	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1082	            )?,
1083	            to_values(
1084	                insights
1085	                    .into_iter()
1086	                    .filter(|insight| {
1087	                        insight_ids.contains(insight.insight_id.as_str())
1088	                            || insight
1089	                                .stimulus
1090	                                .iter()
1091	                                .any(|item| signal_ids.contains(item.signal_id.as_str()))
1092	                    })
1093	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1094	            )?,
1095	            to_values(vec![proposal])?,
1096	        ));
1097	    }
1098	
1099	    let matching_episodes = episodes
1100	        .into_iter()
1101	        .filter(|episode| episode.run_id == source_id)
1102	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1103	    if matching_episodes.is_empty() {
1104	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1105	            "no indexed run or proposal {source_id}; try: deadreckon learn index --all"
1106	        )));
1107	    }
1108	    let run_ids = matching_episodes
1109	        .iter()
1110	        .map(|episode| episode.run_id.as_str())
1111	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1112	    let matching_signals = signals
1113	        .into_iter()
1114	        .filter(|signal| run_ids.contains(signal.run_id.as_str()))
1115	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1116	    let signal_ids = matching_signals
1117	        .iter()
1118	        .map(|signal| signal.signal_id.clone())
1119	        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1120	    Ok((
1121	        "run".to_string(),
1122	        to_values(matching_episodes)?,
1123	        to_values(matching_signals)?,
1124	        to_values(
1125	            insights
1126	                .into_iter()
1127	                .filter(|insight| {
1128	                    insight
1129	                        .stimulus
1130	                        .iter()
1131	                        .any(|item| signal_ids.contains(&item.signal_id))
1132	                })
1133	                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1134	        )?,
1135	        to_values(
1136	            proposals
1137	                .into_iter()
1138	                .filter(|proposal| {
1139	                    proposal
1140	                        .stimulus
1141	                        .iter()
1142	                        .any(|item| signal_ids.contains(&item.signal_id))
1143	                })
1144	                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1145	        )?,
1146	    ))
1147	}

1157	        .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
1158	        .filter(|entry| entry.file_type().is_file())

1182	fn to_values<T>(items: Vec<T>) -> Result<Vec<Value>>

1184	    T: Serialize,

1188	        .map(|item| {

1200	{

1203	        .cloned()

1209	        })

1213	fn verify_learning_bundle(bundle: &LearningBundle) -> Result<()> {
1214	    if bundle.version != LEARNING_SCHEMA_VERSION {
1215	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1216	            "unsupported learning schema version {}",
1217	            bundle.version
1218	        )));
1219	    }
1220	    if !bundle.redacted {
1221	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1222	            "learning bundle must be redacted; try: deadreckon learn export <id> --redacted"
1223	                .to_string(),
1224	        ));
1225	    }
1226	    let actual = bundle_hashes(bundle)?;
1227	    for (section, expected) in &bundle.hashes {
1228	        if actual.get(section) != Some(expected) {
1229	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
1230	                "bundle hash mismatch for {section}; try: deadreckon learn export <id> --redacted"
1231	            )));
1232	        }
1233	    }
1234	    if actual.len() != bundle.hashes.len() {
1235	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
1236	            "bundle hash manifest is incomplete; try: deadreckon learn export <id> --redacted"
1237	                .to_string(),
1238	        ));
1239	    }
1240	    Ok(())
1241	}
1242	
1243	fn bundle_hashes(bundle: &LearningBundle) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>> {
1244	    let mut hashes = BTreeMap::new();
1245	    hashes.insert("episodes".to_string(), hash_json_values(&bundle.episodes)?);
1246	    hashes.insert("signals".to_string(), hash_json_values(&bundle.signals)?);
1247	    hashes.insert("insights".to_string(), hash_json_values(&bundle.insights)?);
1248	    hashes.insert(
1249	        "proposals".to_string(),
1250	        hash_json_values(&bundle.proposals)?,
1251	    );
1252	    Ok(hashes)
1253	}

1255	fn hash_json_values(values: &[Value]) -> Result<String> {
1256	    let raw = serde_json::to_vec(values).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
1257	        path: PathBuf::from("<learning-bundle-hash>"),
1258	        source,
1259	    })?;
1260	    Ok(format!("sha256:{}", sha256_hex(&raw)))
1261	}

1263	fn redact_bundle_values(
1264	    values: Vec<Value>,
1265	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1266	    findings: &mut Vec<String>,
1267	) -> Vec<Value> {
1268	    values
1269	        .into_iter()
1270	        .map(|value| redact_bundle_value(value, paths, findings))
1271	        .collect()
1272	}

1274	fn redact_bundle_value(value: Value, paths: &DeadreckonPaths, findings: &mut Vec<String>) -> Value {
1275	    match value {
1276	        Value::String(raw) => Value::String(redact_learning_string(&raw, paths, findings)),
1277	        Value::Array(items) => Value::Array(
1278	            items
1279	                .into_iter()
1280	                .map(|item| redact_bundle_value(item, paths, findings))
1281	                .collect(),
1282	        ),
1283	        Value::Object(map) => Value::Object(
1284	            map.into_iter()
1285	                .map(|(key, value)| (key, redact_bundle_value(value, paths, findings)))
1286	                .collect(),
1287	        ),
1288	        other => other,
1289	    }
1290	}
1291	
1292	fn redact_learning_string(
1293	    value: &str,
1294	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1295	    findings: &mut Vec<String>,
1296	) -> String {
1297	    if secret_like(value) {
1298	        findings.push("secret-like value redacted".to_string());
1299	        return "<redacted-secret>".to_string();
1300	    }
1301	    let mut redacted = value.to_string();
1302	    let home = paths.home().to_string_lossy();
1303	    if !home.is_empty() && redacted.contains(home.as_ref()) {
1304	        findings.push("deadreckon home path redacted".to_string());
1305	        redacted = redacted.replace(home.as_ref(), "<deadreckon-home>");
1306	    }
1307	    if redacted.contains(SOURCE_ROOT) {
1308	        findings.push("project root path redacted".to_string());
1309	        redacted = redacted.replace(SOURCE_ROOT, "<project-root>");
1310	    }
1311	    if let Ok(user_home) = std::env::var("HOME")
1312	        && !user_home.is_empty()
1313	        && redacted.contains(&user_home)
1314	    {
1315	        findings.push("user home path redacted".to_string());
1316	        redacted = redacted.replace(&user_home, "<home>");
1317	    }
1318	    redacted
1319	}
1320	
1321	fn secret_like(value: &str) -> bool {
1322	    let lower = value.to_ascii_lowercase();
1323	    lower.contains("ghp_")
1324	        || lower.contains("github_pat_")
1325	        || lower.contains("sk-")
1326	        || lower.contains("api_key")
1327	        || lower.contains("api-key")
1328	        || lower.contains("begin openssh private key")
1329	        || lower.contains("begin private key")
1330	}

1332	fn discover_state_paths(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Vec<PathBuf> {

1335	        return Vec::new();
1336	    }
1337	    let mut state_paths = Vec::new();
1338	    for entry in WalkDir::new(&root)
1339	        .max_depth(4)
1340	        .into_iter()
1341	        .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
1342	    {
1343	        if entry.file_type().is_file() && entry.file_name() == "state.json" {
1344	            state_paths.push(entry.path().to_path_buf());
1345	        }
1346	    }
1347	    state_paths.sort();
1348	    state_paths
1349	}

1365	        .join(FLIGHT_EVENTS_JSONL)

1367	        .then(|| path_relative_to(&state.run_root.join(FLIGHT_EVENTS_JSONL), paths.home()));
1368	    let provider_routes = state
1369	        .provider

1371	        .map(|provider| {

1376	        })
1377	        .unwrap_or_default();
1378	    let done_criteria = if acceptance_spec_path_for_run_root(&state.run_root).exists() {

1386	            weak: true,

1389	    Ok(LearningEpisode {
1390	        version: LEARNING_SCHEMA_VERSION,
1391	        run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
1392	        scope: state.scope.clone(),
1393	        task_key: state.task_key.clone(),
1394	        project_root_hash: sha256_hex(state.cwd.to_string_lossy().as_bytes()),
1395	        created_at: state.started_at,

1397	        operation_mode: operation_mode(state),
1398	        provider_routes,
1399	        sandbox: LearningSandbox {
1400	            backend: state.sandbox.clone(),
1401	            mode: codebase_mode_for_state(state),
1402	        },
1403	        goal_digest: sha256_hex(state.goal.as_bytes()),
1404	        goal_summary: redact_text(&summarize(&state.goal), paths, state),
1405	        outcome: run_status_outcome(state.status).to_string(),
1406	        done_criteria,
1407	        metrics: LearningEpisodeMetrics {
1408	            turns: state.turn,
1409	            wall_seconds: spend.wall_seconds,
1410	            spend_usd: spend.total_usd,
1411	            gate_failures,
1412	            doc_warnings,
1413	            rewinds,
1414	        },

1427	fn write_episode(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, episode: &LearningEpisode) -> Result<WriteStatus> {

1433	fn write_if_changed(path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<WriteStatus> {
1434	    let with_newline = if data.ends_with(b"\n") {
1435	        data.to_vec()
1436	    } else {
1437	        let mut value = data.to_vec();
1438	        value.push(b'\n');
1439	        value
1440	    };
1441	    if let Ok(existing) = fs::read(path)
1442	        && existing == with_newline
1443	    {
1444	        return Ok(WriteStatus::Unchanged);
1445	    }
1446	    let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
1447	        DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!("path has no parent: {}", path.display()))
1448	    })?;
1449	    fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
1450	    let mut temp = NamedTempFile::new_in(parent).with_path(parent)?;
1451	    temp.write_all(&with_newline).with_path(path)?;
1452	    temp.as_file_mut().sync_all().with_path(path)?;
1453	    temp.persist(path).map_err(|err| DeadreckonError::Io {
1454	        path: path.to_path_buf(),
1455	        source: err.error,
1456	    })?;
1457	    Ok(WriteStatus::Wrote)
1458	}

1460	fn extract_signals(episodes: &[(LearningEpisode, PipelineState)]) -> Vec<LearningSignal> {
1461	    let mut signals = Vec::new();
1462	    let mut failed_task_counts = BTreeMap::<String, usize>::new();
1463	    for (episode, _state) in episodes {
1464	        if matches!(episode.outcome.as_str(), "failed" | "killed") {
1465	            *failed_task_counts
1466	                .entry(episode.task_key.clone())
1467	                .or_insert(0) += 1;
1468	        }
1469	    }
1470	
1471	    for (episode, state) in episodes {
1472	        if state
1473	            .failure_reason
1474	            .as_deref()
1475	            .is_some_and(provider_setup_failure)
1476	        {
1477	            signals.push(signal(
1478	                episode,
1479	                "setup_friction",
1480	                "high",
1481	                0.90,
1482	                "provider setup or route failure blocked the run",
1483	                RUN_EVENTS_JSONL,

1491	                0.86,
1492	                "done criteria failed before the run recovered or stopped",
1493	                ACCEPTANCE_PROGRESS_JSONL,
1494	            ));
1495	        }
1496	        if episode
1497	            .provider_routes
1498	            .iter()
1499	            .any(|route| route.id.starts_with("cli:"))
1500	            && episode.artifacts.flight.is_none()
1501	        {
1502	            signals.push(signal(
1503	                episode,
1504	                "provider_gap",
1505	                "medium",
1506	                0.78,
1507	                "CLI provider run has no provider-native flight events",
1508	                FLIGHT_MANIFEST_JSON,
1509	            ));
1510	        }
1511	        if episode.metrics.wall_seconds >= 900.0 && episode.metrics.turns <= 1 {
1512	            signals.push(signal(
1513	                episode,
1514	                "slow_path",
1515	                "medium",
1516	                0.72,
1517	                "long wallclock with little visible turn progress",
1518	                "spend.jsonl",
1519	            ));
1520	        }
1521	        if episode.metrics.doc_warnings > 0 {
1522	            signals.push(signal(
1523	                episode,
1524	                "docs_drift",
1525	                "medium",
1526	                0.80,

1530	        }
1531	        if episode.metrics.spend_usd >= 5.0 {

1536	                0.70,

1538	                "spend.jsonl",

1540	        }
1541	        if failed_task_counts

10	pub(crate) struct TuiEventFeed {

24	impl TuiEventFeed {
25	    #[cfg(test)]
26	    pub(crate) fn from_broadcast(
27	        receiver: broadcast::Receiver<RunEvent>,
28	        replay_path: impl Into<PathBuf>,
29	    ) -> Self {
30	        Self {
31	            source: TuiEventSource::Broadcast {
32	                receiver,
33	                replay: JsonlTail::new(replay_path.into()),
34	            },
35	            seen: BTreeSet::new(),
36	        }
37	    }
38	
39	    pub(crate) fn file_tail(path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
40	        Self {
41	            source: TuiEventSource::FileTail(JsonlTail::new(path.into())),
42	            seen: BTreeSet::new(),
43	        }
44	    }
45	
46	    pub(crate) async fn refresh(&mut self, wait: Duration) -> std::io::Result<Vec<RunEvent>> {
47	        let mut events = Vec::new();
48	        match &mut self.source {
49	            TuiEventSource::Broadcast { receiver, replay } => {
50	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
51	                if events.is_empty() && !wait.is_zero() {
52	                    match tokio::time::timeout(wait, receiver.recv()).await {
53	                        Ok(Ok(event)) => events.push(event),
54	                        Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)))
55	                        | Ok(Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed)) => {
56	                            events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
57	                        }
58	                        Err(_) => {}
59	                    }
60	                }
61	                drain_receiver(receiver, &mut events);
62	                if events.is_empty() {
63	                    events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
64	                } else {
65	                    replay.skip_to_end();
66	                }
67	            }
68	            TuiEventSource::FileTail(replay) => {
69	                events.extend(replay.read_new()?);
70	            }
71	        }
72	        Ok(self.dedupe(events))
73	    }
74	
75	    #[cfg(test)]
76	    fn is_broadcast(&self) -> bool {
77	        matches!(self.source, TuiEventSource::Broadcast { .. })
78	    }
79	}

81	fn drain_receiver(receiver: &mut broadcast::Receiver<RunEvent>, events: &mut Vec<RunEvent>) {
82	    loop {
83	        match receiver.try_recv() {
84	            Ok(event) => events.push(event),
85	            Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Lagged(_)) => continue,
86	            Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Empty)
87	            | Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Closed) => break,
88	        }
89	    }
90	}

99	                });
100	                self.seen.insert(key)

248	pub fn create_worktree(record: &CodebaseRecord) -> Result<()> {
249	    if record.mode != CodebaseMode::Worktree {
250	        return Ok(());
251	    }
252	    let git_root = required_path(record.source_git_root.as_ref(), "source_git_root")?;
253	    let worktree_path = required_path(record.worktree_path.as_ref(), "worktree_path")?;
254	    let branch = required_string(record.branch_name.as_deref(), "branch_name")?;
255	    let base = required_string(record.base_ref.as_deref(), "base_ref")?;
256	    if let Some(parent) = worktree_path.parent() {
257	        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
258	    }
259	    git_status(
260	        git_root,
261	        &[
262	            "worktree",
263	            "add",
264	            "-b",
265	            branch,
266	            path_str(worktree_path)?,
267	            base,
268	        ],
269	    )?;
270	    append_git_exclude(git_root, ".deadreckon/")?;
271	    if record.dirty_files_seeded {
272	        seed_dirty_files(git_root, worktree_path)?;
273	    }
274	    Ok(())
275	}

277	pub fn copy_source_to_working(source: &Path, working_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {
278	    if !source.exists() {
279	        return Err(DeadreckonError::NotFound(format!(
280	            "source {}",
281	            source.display()
282	        )));
283	    }
284	    for entry in ignore::WalkBuilder::new(source)
285	        .hidden(false)
286	        .parents(true)
287	        .git_ignore(true)
288	        .git_global(true)
289	        .git_exclude(true)
290	        .build()
291	        .filter_map(std::result::Result::ok)
292	    {
293	        let path = entry.path();
294	        if path == source || ignored_copy_path(source, path) {
295	            continue;
296	        }
297	        let relative = path.strip_prefix(source).unwrap_or(path);
298	        let dest = working_dir.join(relative);
299	        if entry.file_type().is_some_and(|kind| kind.is_dir()) {
300	            std::fs::create_dir_all(&dest).with_path(&dest)?;
301	        } else if entry.file_type().is_some_and(|kind| kind.is_file()) {
302	            if let Some(parent) = dest.parent() {
303	                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
304	            }
305	            std::fs::copy(path, &dest).with_path(path)?;
306	        }
307	    }
308	    Ok(())
309	}

318	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "no-commits".to_string()),
319	        git_root,

323	pub fn current_branch(git_root: &Path) -> Result<String> {
324	    git_stdout(git_root, &["symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD"]).and_then(|branch| {
325	        if branch.is_empty() {
326	            Err(user_error("HEAD is detached", "git switch -c <branch>"))
327	        } else {
328	            Ok(branch)
329	        }
330	    })
331	}
332	
333	pub fn preflight_worktree(git_root: &Path, base_ref: &str, allow_dirty: bool) -> Result<()> {
334	    let head = git_stdout(git_root, &["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
335	        .map_err(|_| user_error("git repo has no commits", "git commit -m initial"))?;
336	    if current_branch(git_root).is_err() {
337	        let short = head.chars().take(12).collect::<String>();
338	        return Err(user_error(
339	            &format!("HEAD is detached at {short}"),
340	            "git switch -c <branch>",
341	        ));
342	    }
343	    if git_path(git_root, "MERGE_HEAD")?.exists() {
344	        return Err(user_error(
345	            "git is in the middle of a merge",
346	            "git merge --abort",
347	        ));
348	    }
349	    if git_path(git_root, "rebase-merge")?.exists() || git_path(git_root, "rebase-apply")?.exists()
350	    {
351	        return Err(user_error(
352	            "git is in the middle of a rebase",
353	            "git rebase --abort",
354	        ));
355	    }
356	    let dirty = git_stdout(git_root, &["status", "--porcelain"])?;
357	    if !allow_dirty && !dirty.trim().is_empty() {
358	        let files = dirty
359	            .lines()
360	            .take(12)
361	            .map(|line| format!("  {}", line.trim()))
362	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
363	            .join("\n");
364	        return Err(user_error(
365	            &format!("working tree has uncommitted changes:\n{files}"),
366	            "git stash && deadreckon run … (or --allow-dirty)",
367	        ));
368	    }
369	    git_stdout(git_root, &["rev-parse", "--verify", base_ref])?;
370	    Ok(())
371	}

425	fn append_git_exclude(git_root: &Path, pattern: &str) -> Result<()> {
426	    let exclude = git_path(git_root, "info/exclude")?;
427	    let existing = std::fs::read_to_string(&exclude).unwrap_or_default();
428	    if existing.lines().any(|line| line.trim() == pattern) {
429	        return Ok(());
430	    }
431	    if let Some(parent) = exclude.parent() {
432	        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
433	    }
434	    use std::io::Write;
435	    let mut file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
436	        .create(true)
437	        .append(true)
438	        .open(&exclude)
439	        .with_path(&exclude)?;
440	    writeln!(file, "{pattern}").with_path(exclude)
441	}

470	fn unique_worktree_path(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, scope: &str, run_id: &str) -> PathBuf {
471	    let stem = format!(
472	        "{}-{}",
473	        sanitize_slug(scope),
474	        &run_id[..run_id.len().min(8)]
475	    );
476	    let root = paths.home().join("worktrees");
477	    let mut candidate = root.join(&stem);
478	    let mut suffix = 2;
479	    while candidate.exists()
480	        && std::fs::read_dir(&candidate)
481	            .map(|mut entries| entries.next().is_some())
482	            .unwrap_or(true)
483	    {
484	        candidate = root.join(format!("{stem}-{suffix}"));
485	        suffix += 1;
486	    }
487	    candidate
488	}

490	fn seed_dirty_files(git_root: &Path, worktree_path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
491	    apply_dirty_diff(git_root, worktree_path, false)?;
492	    apply_dirty_diff(git_root, worktree_path, true)?;
493	    let dirty = git_stdout(git_root, &["status", "--porcelain"])?;
494	    for line in dirty.lines() {
495	        if line.len() < 4 {
496	            continue;
497	        }
498	        if !line.starts_with("?? ") {
499	            continue;
500	        }
501	        let relative = line[3..].trim().trim_matches('"');
502	        if relative.contains(" -> ") {
503	            continue;
504	        }
505	        let source = git_root.join(relative);
506	        let dest = worktree_path.join(relative);
507	        if source.is_file() {
508	            if let Some(parent) = dest.parent() {
509	                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
510	            }
511	            std::fs::copy(&source, &dest).with_path(&source)?;
512	        }
513	    }
514	    Ok(())
515	}

517	fn apply_dirty_diff(git_root: &Path, worktree_path: &Path, staged: bool) -> Result<()> {
518	    let mut diff_args = vec!["diff", "--binary"];
519	    if staged {
520	        diff_args.push("--cached");
521	    }
522	    let output = run_git(git_root, &diff_args)?;
523	    if !output.status.success() {
524	        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
525	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(if stderr.is_empty() {
526	            format!("git {:?} failed", diff_args)
527	        } else {
528	            stderr
529	        }));
530	    }
531	    if output.stdout.is_empty() {
532	        return Ok(());
533	    }
534	    let output = run_git_with_input(
535	        worktree_path,
536	        &["apply", "--whitespace=nowarn", "-"],
537	        &output.stdout,
538	    )?;
539	    if output.status.success() {
540	        Ok(())
541	    } else {
542	        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
543	        Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(if stderr.is_empty() {
544	            "git apply dirty diff failed".to_string()
545	        } else {
546	            stderr
547	        }))
548	    }
549	}

551	fn ignored_copy_path(source: &Path, path: &Path) -> bool {

554	        .and_then(|relative| relative.components().next())
555	        .is_some_and(|component| {

557	            name == ".git" || name == "target" || name == "node_modules"
558	        })

364	fn step_transition_allowed(from: ChainStepStatus, to: ChainStepStatus) -> bool {
365	    use ChainStepStatus::{Applied, Completed, Failed, Pending, Running, Skipped, Undone};
366	    matches!(
367	        (from, to),
368	        (Pending, Running)
369	            | (Pending, Skipped)
370	            | (Pending, Failed)
371	            | (Running, Completed)
372	            | (Running, Failed)
373	            | (Running, Skipped)
374	            | (Completed, Applied)
375	            | (Completed, Failed)
376	            | (Completed, Pending)
377	            | (Failed, Pending)
378	            | (Applied, Pending)
379	            | (Applied, Undone)
380	            | (Skipped, Pending)
381	            | (Undone, Pending)
382	    )
383	}

420	pub fn validate_task_count(count: usize) -> Result<()> {
421	    match count {
422	        0 | 1 => Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
423	            "plan must have >= 2 children\ntry: deadreckon run \"<the only child>\"".to_string(),
424	        )),
425	        2..=6 => Ok(()),
426	        _ => Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
427	            "plan capped at 6 children; got {count}\ntry: split the goal into a chain"
428	        ))),
429	    }
430	}
431	
432	pub fn validate_task_graph(tasks: &[PlanTask]) -> Result<()> {
433	    validate_task_count(tasks.len())?;
434	    let mut ids = BTreeSet::new();
435	    let mut subjects = BTreeSet::new();
436	    for (expected_index, task) in tasks.iter().enumerate() {
437	        if task.index != expected_index as u32 {
438	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
439	                "child {} has index {}; expected {expected_index}",
440	                task.task_id, task.index
441	            )));
442	        }
443	        validate_nonempty(&task.task_id, "task_id")?;
444	        validate_nonempty(&task.subject, "subject")?;
445	        validate_nonempty(&task.goal, "goal")?;
446	        if !ids.insert(task.task_id.as_str()) {
447	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
448	                "duplicate child id {}",
449	                task.task_id
450	            )));
451	        }
452	        let normalized_subject = task
453	            .subject
454	            .split_whitespace()
455	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
456	            .join(" ")
457	            .to_ascii_lowercase();
458	        if !subjects.insert(normalized_subject) {
459	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
460	                "duplicate child subject {}",
461	                task.subject
462	            )));
463	        }
464	    }
465	    for task in tasks {
466	        for dependency in &task.depends_on {
467	            if !ids.contains(dependency.as_str()) {
468	                return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
469	                    "child {} depends on unknown child {dependency}",
470	                    task.task_id
471	                )));
472	            }
473	            if dependency == &task.task_id {
474	                return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
475	                    "child {} depends on itself",
476	                    task.task_id
477	                )));
478	            }
479	        }
480	    }
481	    detect_task_cycle(tasks)?;
482	    Ok(())
483	}

578	pub fn write_plan_narrative(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, plan: &Plan) -> Result<PathBuf> {
579	    let path = plan_narrative_path(paths, &plan.plan_id);
580	    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
581	        fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
582	    }
583	
584	    let mut out = String::new();
585	    out.push_str("# Plan Narrative\n\n");
586	    out.push_str(&format!("**Plan ID:** `{}`\n", plan.plan_id));
587	    out.push_str(&format!("**Status:** {}\n", plan_status_label(plan.status)));
588	    out.push_str(&format!("**Goal:** {}\n", plan.root_goal));
589	    out.push_str(&format!("**Mode:** {}\n", plan.mode.as_str()));
590	    if let Some(run_id) = plan.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
591	        out.push_str(&format!("**Result run:** `{run_id}`\n"));
592	    }
593	    out.push_str("\n## Reading Order\n\n");
594	    out.push_str(
595	        "Start with this plan narrative, then read the child summaries below for the work each child completed.\n\n",
596	    );
597	    out.push_str("## Child Summaries\n\n");
598	
599	    for task in &plan.tasks {
600	        out.push_str(&format!("### Child {}: {}\n\n", task.index, task.subject));
601	        out.push_str(&format!("- Child id: `{}`\n", task.task_id));
602	        out.push_str(&format!("- Role: {}\n", plan_role_label(task.role)));
603	        out.push_str(&format!(
604	            "- Status: {}\n",
605	            plan_task_status_label(task.status)
606	        ));
607	        if let Some(run_id) = task.child_run_id.as_deref() {
608	            out.push_str(&format!("- Run: `{run_id}`\n"));
609	        }
610	        if task.depends_on.is_empty() {
611	            out.push_str("- Dependencies: none\n");
612	        } else {
613	            out.push_str(&format!("- Dependencies: {}\n", task.depends_on.join(", ")));
614	        }
615	        out.push('\n');
616	
617	        let summary_path = task
618	            .summary_path
619	            .as_ref()
620	            .map(|relative| paths.plan_dir(&plan.plan_id).join(relative))
621	            .unwrap_or_else(|| paths.child_summary(&plan.plan_id, &task.task_id));
622	        let summary = fs::read_to_string(&summary_path)
623	            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "No child summary was recorded for this child.".to_string());
624	        out.push_str(summary.trim());
625	        out.push_str("\n\n");
626	    }
627	
628	    fs::write(&path, out).with_path(&path)?;
629	    Ok(path)
630	}

679	            | PlanMessageKind::ReviewResponse

692	fn detect_task_cycle(tasks: &[PlanTask]) -> Result<()> {
693	    #[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
694	    enum Mark {
695	        Visiting,
696	        Done,
697	    }
698	    fn visit<'a>(
699	        id: &'a str,
700	        by_id: &BTreeMap<&'a str, &'a PlanTask>,
701	        marks: &mut BTreeMap<&'a str, Mark>,
702	    ) -> Result<()> {
703	        match marks.get(id) {
704	            Some(Mark::Visiting) => {
705	                return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
706	                    "child dependency cycle at {id}\ntry: remove one depends_on edge"
707	                )));
708	            }
709	            Some(Mark::Done) => return Ok(()),
710	            None => {}
711	        }
712	        marks.insert(id, Mark::Visiting);
713	        if let Some(task) = by_id.get(id) {
714	            for dependency in &task.depends_on {
715	                visit(dependency, by_id, marks)?;
716	            }
717	        }
718	        marks.insert(id, Mark::Done);
719	        Ok(())
720	    }
721	
722	    let by_id = tasks
723	        .iter()
724	        .map(|task| (task.task_id.as_str(), task))
725	        .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
726	    let mut marks = BTreeMap::new();
727	    for task in tasks {
728	        visit(&task.task_id, &by_id, &mut marks)?;
729	    }
730	    Ok(())
731	}

12	pub const INSTALL_RECEIPT_VERSION: u32 = 1;
13	
14	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
15	#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
16	pub enum Channel {
17	    Npm,
18	    Brew,
19	    Shell,
20	    Cargo,
21	    Source,
22	}
23	
24	impl Channel {
25	    #[must_use]
26	    pub const fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
27	        match self {
28	            Self::Npm => "npm",
29	            Self::Brew => "brew",
30	            Self::Shell => "shell",
31	            Self::Cargo => "cargo",
32	            Self::Source => "source",
33	        }
34	    }
35	}

37	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
38	pub struct Receipt {
39	    pub channel: Channel,
40	    pub channel_version: String,
41	    pub binary_path: PathBuf,
42	    pub installed_at: DateTime<Utc>,
43	    pub install_source: Option<String>,
44	    pub platform_package: Option<String>,
45	    pub receipt_version: u32,
46	}
47	
48	#[must_use]
49	pub fn receipt_path(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> PathBuf {
50	    paths.home().join(INSTALL_RECEIPT_FILE)
51	}
52	
53	pub fn read_receipt(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Result<Option<Receipt>> {
54	    let path = receipt_path(paths);
55	    let raw = match fs::read(&path) {
56	        Ok(raw) => raw,
57	        Err(source) if source.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(None),
58	        Err(source) => return Err(crate::DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
59	    };
60	    serde_json::from_slice(&raw).with_json_path(path).map(Some)
61	}
62	
63	pub fn write_receipt(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, receipt: &Receipt) -> Result<()> {
64	    let path = receipt_path(paths);
65	    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
66	        fs::create_dir_all(parent).with_path(parent)?;
67	    }
68	    let raw = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(receipt).with_json_path(&path)?;
69	    fs::write(&path, raw).with_path(path)
70	}
71	
72	#[must_use]
73	pub fn detect_channel(binary_path: &Path) -> Channel {
74	    let normalized = binary_path
75	        .to_string_lossy()
76	        .replace('\\', "/")
77	        .to_ascii_lowercase();
78	
79	    if normalized.contains("/node_modules/deadreckon/")
80	        || normalized.contains("/node_modules/deadreckon-")
81	    {
82	        return Channel::Npm;
83	    }
84	    if normalized.contains("/cellar/deadreckon/") {
85	        return Channel::Brew;
86	    }
87	    if normalized.contains("/.cargo/bin/deadreckon") {
88	        return Channel::Cargo;
89	    }
90	    if normalized.contains("/.local/share/deadreckon/")
91	        || normalized.contains("/appdata/local/deadreckon/")
92	    {
93	        return Channel::Shell;
94	    }
95	
96	    Channel::Source
97	}
98	
99	#[must_use]
100	pub fn detect_receipt(binary_path: &Path) -> Receipt {
101	    let channel = detect_channel(binary_path);
102	    Receipt {
103	        channel,
104	        channel_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
105	        binary_path: binary_path.to_path_buf(),
106	        installed_at: Utc::now(),
107	        install_source: Some("detected".to_string()),
108	        platform_package: (channel == Channel::Npm).then(platform_package_for_current),
109	        receipt_version: INSTALL_RECEIPT_VERSION,
110	    }
111	}
112	
113	#[must_use]
114	pub fn platform_package_for_current() -> String {
115	    platform_package_for(std::env::consts::OS, std::env::consts::ARCH)
116	        .unwrap_or_else(|| "deadreckon-unknown-unknown".to_string())
117	}
118	
119	#[must_use]
120	pub fn platform_package_for(os: &str, arch: &str) -> Option<String> {
121	    let os = match os {
122	        "macos" => "darwin",
123	        "linux" => "linux",
124	        "windows" => "win32",
125	        _ => return None,
126	    };
127	    let arch = match arch {
128	        "x86_64" | "x64" => "x64",
129	        "aarch64" | "arm64" => "arm64",
130	        _ => return None,
131	    };
132	    Some(format!("deadreckon-{os}-{arch}"))
133	}

347	            path: path.into(),

350	            _marker: PhantomData,
351	        }
352	    }
353	
354	    fn read_new(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<Vec<T>> {
355	        let Some(mut file) = self.open_at_offset()? else {
356	            return Ok(Vec::new());
357	        };
358	        let mut raw = String::new();
359	        file.read_to_string(&mut raw)?;
360	        self.offset = file.stream_position()?;
361	        if raw.is_empty() {
362	            return Ok(Vec::new());
363	        }
364	        let mut buffer = String::new();
365	        std::mem::swap(&mut buffer, &mut self.partial);
366	        buffer.push_str(&raw);

240	pub fn frontmatter(state: &PipelineState, fields: &FrontmatterFields) -> String {
241	    let mut lines = Vec::new();
242	    lines.push(format!("# {}", title_from_goal(&state.goal)));
243	    lines.push(String::new());
244	    lines.push(format!("**Date:** {}", state.started_at.to_rfc3339()));
245	    lines.push(format!(
246	        "**Last updated:** {}",
247	        fields.last_updated.to_rfc3339()
248	    ));
249	    lines.push(format!("**Status:** {} (alpha)", state.status));
250	    lines.push(format!("**Run ID:** `{}`", state.run_id));
251	    lines.push(format!("**Goal:** {}", state.goal));
252	    if let Some(parent) = fields.parent_run_id.as_deref() {
253	        lines.push(format!("**Parent run:** `{}`", short_id(parent)));
254	    }
255	    lines.extend(commit_or_working_lines(state));
256	    lines.push(format!("**Owner:** {}", owner_line(state)));
257	    lines.push(format!(
258	        "**Provider:** {}",
259	        state.provider.as_deref().unwrap_or("unconfigured")
260	    ));
261	    lines.push(format!("**Sandbox:** {}", state.sandbox));
262	    lines.push(format!("**Spend:** {}", spend_line(state)));
263	    lines.push(format!("**Doc-writer:** {}", fields.doc_writer));
264	    lines.push(String::new());
265	    lines.join("\n")
266	}

268	pub fn append_turn_doc(state: &PipelineState, input: TurnDocInput) -> Result<TurnRecord> {
269	    ensure_docs_started(state)?;
270	    let normalized_files = normalize_files(state, &input.files);
271	    let file_changes = capture_diff_samples(state, input.turn, &input.files)?;
272	    let title = auto_title(
273	        &input.response_text,
274	        &input.tool_kind,
275	        &normalized_files,
276	        input.turn,
277	    );
278	    let response_full = capture_response_full(&input.response_text);
279	    let response_summary = capture_response_summary(&response_full);
280	    let record = TurnRecord {
281	        turn: input.turn,
282	        title,
283	        tool_kind: input.tool_kind,
284	        latency_ms: input.latency_ms,
285	        files: file_changes,
286	        outcome: input.outcome,
287	        response_full,
288	        response_summary,
289	        tool_stdout: input.tool_stdout.as_deref().map(capture_tool_stdio),
290	        tool_stderr: input.tool_stderr.as_deref().map(capture_tool_stdio),
291	        trace_link: format!("../traces.jsonl#turn-{}", input.turn),
292	        snapshot_link: format!("../../snapshots/turn-{}/", input.turn),
293	        commit_sha: current_worktree_sha(state),
294	        decision_candidate: is_decision_candidate(&input.response_text),
295	        response_text: input.response_text,
296	    };
297	    append_json_line(&incremental_path(&state.working_dir), &record)?;
298	    rewrite_templated_docs(state, "templated only")?;
299	    Ok(record)
300	}

310	        .unwrap_or(response)
